title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: Navigating Global Risk (Podcast)

The selloff in the US bond market deepened on Monday after President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, dampening hopes of a diplomatic breakthrough to end the war. The decline pushed most Treasury yields higher by nearly 10 basis points by noon in New York, with those on 10-year bonds climbing to a fresh 19-year high. Patrick Murphy, Executive Director at Hilco Global Geopolitical Unit, former Acting Secretary of the Army & US Congressman
Bob Chapek, former Disney CEO

Ed Ludlow, 'Bloomberg Tech' Host (Source: Bloomberg)
